reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — the rendered paragraphs are identical to the originals.

The cited text supports the classification: §10 (p0065) grants a 'renewable one-year term' with no 'automatically renew' or non-renewal notice language, and §17(a) (p0117) makes the licence perpetual while fees are paid, so there is no auto-renewal, no notice window to compute, and no multi-year renewal — neither the fallback nor walk-away thresholds are engaged.

The failed deterministic check ('non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days: number not found') is consistent with the rationale rather than contradicting it: the absence of a notice-window figure is expected where renewal is not automatic, so it is not evidence of a deviation.

The absent price-uplift cap is correctly treated as a rationale note (a minor sub-element short of preferred wording) rather than a deviation, and the customer-side 90-day termination-for-convenience right in §17(b) is correctly excluded as a benefit to our party.
